observations.claim: Knorr-Bremse's own June 19, 2026 newsroom publication, speaking for its Bendix subsidiary, confirms Bendix announced an agreement with Aeva to develop an active safety solution integrating Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors and perception software into future Bendix collision-mitigation systems for Class 8 trucks. This adds partner-side provenance beyond Aeva's issuer announcement; the agreement is a development program, not evidence of deployed production or booked unit volumes.

limitations: Partner-parent primary corroboration is distinct in provenance from issuer-side claims, but cannot by itself complete Alpha's source-integrity specialist perspective or numeric data-confidence evidence.
Does not establish binding production volumes, delivered vehicles, realized revenue, price/margins, or completed OEM qualification.
No score, underwriting, adjudication, or Alpha authority asserted.

methodology: Methodology 1.0 preserved; append-only source acquisition; Beast/integrity gates and Earth Core canonical authority unchanged.
